title: Weather station
automatic_bulletin: Observation summary; forecasts from the selected weather provider.
bulletin_empty: Select local entities and a weather source in settings.
forecast_empty: Hourly forecasts unavailable. Select a compatible weather entity.
tomorrow_empty: Tomorrow’s forecast unavailable for the selected source.
forecast_error: Unable to retrieve forecasts. Check the weather entity and its logs.
history_error: History inaccessible: check History and the entities recorded by Recorder.
footer: Observations: local station · Forecasts: selected weather provider
auto_note: Detects WS90 SBWS-90CM D693 and maps its sensors without renaming them. Select forecast and bulletin sources separately.
ambiguous_note: Some ambiguous entities must be selected manually.
disabled_note: Some entities are disabled in Home Assistant; enable those you need in BTHome.
catalog_error: Unable to read the BTHome registry. Select entities manually.
irradiance_note: Lux → W/m² depends on the light spectrum and is not an irradiance measurement. A selected W/m² sensor takes priority. Only correct absolute pressure to sea level; do not correct an already compensated value.
entities_note: Suggestions match the measurement type; AdGuard entities are excluded. Entity IDs can also be entered manually. Empty fields display — or generate the bulletin automatically. Autoconfig never renames entities.
weather_note: Choose a weather entity for forecasts. The fallback fills only missing values for the same hour or day; zero values are preserved. Expired hours are excluded. Missing data from both sources is displayed as a dash.
notifications_note: Alerts run in Home Assistant even when this panel is closed. Enable them and select recipients.
targets_unavailable: No notification actions available. Check your notification integrations.
notify_storm: Weather source reports thunderstorms now or within the next 3 hours
notification_cooldown: Minimum interval between alerts of the same type (minutes)
notifications_warmup: Pressure is sampled every minute: this alert needs 3 hours after a restart or sensor change. Alerts fire when triggered and rearm after the condition clears. Hourly forecasts are checked every 10 minutes.
orientation_heading: Your facing direction / top of screen (°)
orientation_note: 0° = north, 90° = east, 155° = southeast. Saved only in this browser for this station on computers and tablets. Phones keep north at the top. The arrow always shows where the wind comes from.
orientation_invalid: Orientation must be at least 0° and less than 360°.
pressure_degradation: Pressure falling sharply: −{drop} hPa over 3 h. Conditions may deteriorate; this alone does not predict a thunderstorm.
pressure_improving: Pressure rising sharply: +{rise} hPa over 3 h. Conditions may improve.
storm_current: The weather source reports a thunderstorm now.
storm_forecast: The weather source forecasts a thunderstorm around {time}.
alert_pressure: Pressure falling sharply: −{drop} hPa over 3 h. Conditions may deteriorate; thunderstorms are not confirmed.
alert_rain: Rain has started at the station.
alert_storm: The weather source reports thunderstorms now or within the next 3 hours.
wind_phrases: Wind from the North|Wind from the Northeast|Wind from the East|Wind from the Southeast|Wind from the South|Wind from the Southwest|Wind from the West|Wind from the Northwest
background_url: Banner photo — URL or local path
background_note: Leave empty for the original landscape. Browse to upload a photo, or enter an HTTPS URL or local path.
upload_done: Photo uploaded. Click Save to apply it.
icons_note: Choose an image for each weather condition: transparent PNG, GIF or WebP, static or animated, JPG (8 MB maximum). Default icons are shown on the left. Save to apply changes to the banner and forecasts.
upload_icon_done: Icon uploaded. Click Save to apply it.
compass_note: Choose a bundled design or upload an image. Compass: transparent image with North at the top. Arrow: transparent SVG pointing up, pivot at the center. The arrow crosses the dial in the direction the air travels. Your screen orientation remains applied.
graph_period: Available history over the past 12 hours
graph_inspect: Hover or touch the curve; arrow keys browse measurements
almanac_enable: Show the daily saint, quote and saying (French source)
map_help: Customize the name, target and visibility of all six buttons. Meteociel map only supports radar, lightning, humidity, rainfall, gusts and satellite maps. The region and viewport come from the URL. For other websites choose Embedded window or New tab. EUMETSAT animation remains available as a satellite alternative.
map_blocked_help: If the map does not appear, open the website or choose New tab in Personalization.
sat_unavailable: Satellite images unavailable. Use the EUMETView link at the bottom right.
sat_old: The most recent available images are more than three hours old.
sat_partial: Some images could not be loaded.
map_loading: Loading the map and recent observations…
map_unavailable: Map unavailable. Use the website link at the bottom right.
map_partial: Some images are unavailable; only complete frames are shown.
map_old: Warning: the latest available observations are old.
map_strike_age: Strike age: yellow = recent, red = older (30 min).
map_embedded_time: Date and time supplied by Meteociel, printed on the map.
